_comment: Shared by lib/src/loro.rs (datatype_tag) and browser/lib/src/datatypes.test.ts (datatypeTag), like the other Rust/TS fixtures in lib/tests/fixtures (mounted into the Dagger lib container). tagged = a plain string value gets the `string` datatype tag, because the untagged reader heuristic would reinterpret it as JSON or a reference. `atomic://` links are not references to that heuristic (is_atomic_identifier excludes them), so they stay untagged.
